answer: Cosignatures are collected in anchor, verified in falcon, and zenith names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and hence paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 21 submissions per epoch. That is 813 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
